Plot raw index values against their random interval

Source: R/plots.R
plot_random_interval.Rd

Plots the raw SPI, ER or IR of each core against its scar count, over the random interval (the central 95% of values from cores with random scar directions; see random_interval()). Cores outside the band depart from what random directions produce at their scar count.

Usage

plot_random_interval(x, parameter = c("SPI", "ER", "IR"), group = NULL)

Arguments

x

The output of spi_ei_batch(), with the columns n_scar and <parameter>_raw.

parameter

"SPI", "ER" or "IR".

group

Optional name of a column of x to colour the cores by.

Value

A ggplot object (requires the ggplot2 package).

See also

random_interval(), spi_ei_batch()

Examples

if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  set.seed(1)
  scars <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:6, function(i) {
    n <- 4 + 3 * i
    s <- matrix(rnorm(3 * n, sd = 10), n, 3)
    d <- matrix(rnorm(3 * n), n, 3)
    d[, 1] <- d[, 1] + (i %% 2)
    data.frame(ID = paste0("core", i), Start_X = s[, 1], Start_Y = s[, 2],
               Start_Z = s[, 3], End_X = s[, 1] + d[, 1],
               End_Y = s[, 2] + d[, 2], End_Z = s[, 3] + d[, 3])
  }))
  fab <- spi_ei_batch(scars, rarefied = FALSE)
  plot_random_interval(fab, "SPI")
}
